name: Pocket Edition
//: Story Phase 11: the Cheap-O-Rama pocket edition of the legends. It wears out as the arc goes on (pocket_legend_book_condition); the description follows it. It never disappears for good.
description: COMPLETE GRAND STENCHMASTER LEGENDS - CHEAP-O-RAMA POCKET EDITION. Free with every sash. Microscopic print. Suspiciously familiar.

variants.description: What's left of the pocket edition: a cover, most of the pages, one staple, and an unshakeable belief that it's history.
The pocket edition, hanging on by one crooked staple. The fine print has been read aloud by five desperate pirates.
The pocket edition. Bent, torn, and the last page half out at the staple: the table. Table A says see Table A.
The pocket edition, cover bent, a corner torn off (your thumb). The table at the back is still there. Unfortunately.
The pocket edition, cover bent where he hugged it. Brogath, Rumpold, the Grand Court, Gustavio. Free with every sash.

name: Toy Sash
description: GRAND STENCHMASTER CEREMONIAL SASH PLAYSET. Red, shiny, synthetic. Ages six and up. It won't tear. Clean. For now.

name: The Plan
description: On the back of a Cheap-O-Rama box: HOLD SASH 30 SECONDS (ME). LET IT FLUTTER. HE MUST NOTICE. CREW GASP AND POINT. 21 DAYS. NO DICE. NO DICE. NO DICE.
